questions.text: How often do you use an AI assistant (for example ChatGPT, Gemini or Copilot) for your work?
Which of these have you done with AI for real work?

options.text: Written or improved a message or email
Checked numbers, a bill or a sheet
Changed how I do a regular task because of AI

questions.text: When AI gives you a number or a fact for your work, what do you usually do?

options.text: Always check it against my records or a trusted source

questions.text: When the first AI answer is not good enough, what do you do?

options.text: Add details about my situation or an example and ask again

questions.text: Before you paste work into an AI tool, do you remove customers' or staff private details?

options.text: I had not thought about it
